title: On hyperbolic PDEs, filtered feedback control laws, and fractal-like stability crossing curves
summary: The paper addresses the boundary control of a class of hyperbolic PDEs, based on an equivalent representation in terms of an integral-difference equation. The situation is considered where direct compensation of reflection terms induces a fragile closed-loop system, in the sense of lack of strong stability. This is theoretically resolved by adding a low-pass filter to the control law, but the choice of its cut-off frequency is crucial in balancing robustness at high frequencies and performance at low frequencies.
